name: Dock
description: Dock (dock.space) is GNTC's AI presentation editor for PowerPoint, Keynote and PDF. Through its hosted MCP server an agent creates a deck from a Dock template or an uploaded .pptx or .key file, edits it with 200+ presentation actions, renders slides to check its own work, sends edits as a proposal that a person accepts in Dock, and exports PPTX or PDF. Sign in with OAuth; MCP access comes with every plan, Free included.
author: GNTC
